tools.name: drift_check
tools.description:
Check ONE proposed action against a signed agent mandate BEFORE it happens. Returns {"verdict": "ALLOW"|"DENY", "rule": <name>} plus a report with a ledger fingerprint.

Six rules run in a fixed order, so a refusal names the most important reason rather than an incidental one: amount, payee, audienc

tools.name: drift_session
tools.description:
Check a SEQUENCE of proposed actions against one mandate. Returns {submitted, allowed, denied, breach_by_rule, fingerprint}.

tools.name: drift_explain
tools.description:
Return the six enforcement rules in the exact order they are applied, each with a plain-language reason it exists. Takes no mandate and no action.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "drift_check" stacks urgency/override words (important, immediately, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
